description_en: Retrieves the configuration of a Logstore
kebab_example: aliyun sls get-log-store-config --project ali-test-project --logstore ali-test-logstore --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetLogStoreConfig

schema.title_en: 是否长链接。取值包括：  close：不是长链接，则每个HTTP请求都会重新建立TCP连接。 keep-alive：长链接，TCP连接建立后保持连接状态，节省连接所需时间和带宽。

clientIpHeaders.description_en: An array of header keys used to extract the client IP address when data is written to the Logstore. The keys are case-insensitive, but their order in the array is significant. For this feature to work, enable the `appendMeta` option on the Logstore. Log Service searches the request headers for these keys in the specified order and adds the first valid IP address it finds as a log tag
clientIpHeaders.description_zh: 配置 logstore 写入时提取 IP 地址的来源 header keys。顺序敏感，大小写不敏感。配置后需要打开 logstore 的 appendMeta 记录外网 Ip 来源功能才会生效，将从请求的 Header 中按照配置的 keys 提取 IP，添加到日志 Tag 中

items.description_en: A case-insensitive header key, such as `X-Forwarded-For`
